name: Silkflex Polymers (India) Ltd.
summary: Silkflex Polymers (India) Ltd. is a company operating in the specialty chemicals industry, primarily focused on the manufacturing, trading, and distribution of water-based polymer products for the textile printing and wood coating sectors in India. The company's main offerings include a diverse portfolio of water-based textile printing inks, which encompass eco-based, non-PVC, screen coatings, glues, specialty effects, additives, and colors. These products are designed for textile manufacturers and garment processors, emphasizing features like soft feel, stretchability, and compliance with environmental standards. Additionally, the company provides water-based wood coating polymers, such as base coats, topcoats, stains, and sealers, which serve the furniture and interior woodwork industries as eco-friendly, low-VOC alternatives to traditional solvent-based products. Silkflex Polymers (India) Ltd. operates on a business-to-business (B2B) model, providing technical assistance and application guidance to its clients. While historically a trading and distribution entity with an exclusive agreement to sell products from Silkflex Polymers SDN BHD of Malaysia in India, the company is transitioning to a manufacturing-led model with a recently established production facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Its target markets include textile hubs across India, and it supplies to global apparel brands.
